description: Open-vocabulary detector requests on one frame (agent only; VLM_NAME). The frame is an inline JPEG, shown as a placeholder.

best-match.description: Grounding a report item (also object tracking's re-anchoring): one box for the label.

content.text: Locate the single best match for "red toolbox" in this image. Only a real, physically present person or object counts: one that only appears on a screen, TV, monitor, poster, sign, picture, painting or reflection does not. Return JSON only, in the form {"bbox_2d": [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax], "label": "<what the box contains>"} with integer coordinates normalised to 0-1000 (0,0 is the top-left corner). If it is not visible, or only shown on a screen, poster, sign, picture or reflection, return {"bbox_2d": null}.
